title: Weak and Strong Fibrations of Functors
summary: We develop a homotopical framework for small categories that extends classical invarints of algebraic topology to the categorical setting. Our approach is based on the construction of genuine path category, obtained trough a localization procedure, which allows us to define strong and weak fibrations for functor. We establish their basic properties, introduce a fibrant replacement for functors, and extend homotopical invariants such as the Svarc genus and sectional category to small categories.
